title: bn254-pairing-inversion: Pure-Scalar C6-m184_w216-rec STNFS with Zero-Retry Metered-DAG Descent (t=2^112), Strict <2^64B Per-Owner Buffers, Closed-Form 3-Prime NTT, sigma-Folded 12D E* Band-3, W_SB=256 SWAR sb_u7, Score-Only Stage B, & Unplanted 5-SM Z[omega] LA: 2^87.470011195

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the self-contained 100% pure-scalar AArch64 algorithm of proof.md (C6-m184_w216-rec content-reduced reciprocal rank-2 totally imaginary sextic tower, order-6 Frobenius tau = Frob^10, exact rational sigma(w) == w twist invariance, score-only 3-band g-side sieving at B_f = 2^61, B_g = 2^60, excess 0.82 with strict < 2^64 B (C_HIT_LO = 13.25 Ir/hit) + early4_find, Band-2 [2^43, 2^55) 8-lane 64-bit SWAR sb_u7 per-SB tight q_min_j gate at W_SB = 256 guaranteeing max_sb = 5 <= 8 on every row + 8B per-owner buffer (C_HIT_HI = 14.5 Ir/hit), Band-3 [2^55, 2^59) sigma-orbit-folded 12D Optimal Bounding Ellipsoid E* = {0.5*u + v/(2*(1-kap)) <= 1} Fincke-Pohst walk on 1/3 as many ideals with exact provable volume ratio VR_12 = 2.238988x over active R = {u <= 1, v + kap*u <= 1}, unconditional chunk-init bound N_chunks <= fp12_nodes_int + N_leaves/512 charging C_FP12_CHUNK_INIT = 120.0 Ir on every internal node + 120/512 per leaf, chunked<=512 outward-rounded pure-integer Q1.60 -mgeneral-regs-only R-gate (20 Ir worst-case charged on all E* leaves, 0 false negatives) + Voronoi unit-FD, uint16_t 64-bit SWAR scan+zero, 100% score-only Stage B stripping the exact 2^14-smooth part m via 417 64-bit prime-product chunks + disjoint large-prime windows with ZERO sieve prime recording and genuine all-89,151-active-cell norm histogram for cof_b divided by n_in once, closed-form 3-prime 64-bit radix-2 Cooley-Tukey NTT + Karatsuba with ZERO H-FFT heuristic, live full de Bruijn rho_dB, un-discounted 5-column random-compressed Schirokauer maps W_f(P_chi Lambda_f) and W_g(P_chi Lambda_g), 1-owner 3-bucket Z[omega] Block Wiedemann (bw = (768, 30), 2^59.61 B) with deterministic pre-merge guard W_avg <= 161.0, zero-column-loss excess-row trim + reverse re-purge back-substitution, and 4-parameter hard caps (N_sw_cap = 0.00160*U', N_l_cap = 0.00098*U', k5_cap = 12.00, tab_r_cap = 0.85, lazy = 0) under fixed-instance premise H3, and live 62-row LB=59 ZERO-RETRY METERED-DAG descent (k = 1, boot_rels = 1) with strictly decreasing norm DAG, ideal-log cache giving P(repeat) = 0, unconditional missing-FB-leaf rejection, unconditional Boole union bound 2*Phi_dag = 0.005871 under reached-ideal ensemble H5 (NB2 r = 2.0, alpha = 0.5), deterministic DAG node count 2*C_det = 1,326, expected DAG/boot work under H-EA, single-owner < 2^64 B boot tree (x_EA = 64.42, root 2^62.95 B), deterministic boot trial cap T_boot_max (fail <= 2e-4), and hard aborting combined-log meter t = 2^112 units with Markov tail E[D]/t = 4.836e-9 < 5e-9 in FIX-U) returns Q = [x] Q0 in G2 with e(P0, Q) = z (charging explicit G2 scalar multiplication output <= 2^11.761903 units) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1 + (K/2^64) * 2^88.819672611 <= 2^87.470011195 units (C = 20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents; strictly an expected-work bound, not an every-run bound), under declared exploratory model inequalities H1-H5, H-EA, H-SM, H-R, H-X, and H-SEP (proof.md Section 6 and RANK-BRIDGE.md; zero H-FFT heuristic). A run gate opens the run iff a fresh 64-bit coin is below K = 7238209549972357173, the least integer with (K/2^64) * 0.993924 >= 0.39; a closed run fails at cost 1 unit. Opened-run success >= 0.993924 is bounded by a strict additive union bound (FIX-U). Finite-scale prototypes provide compatibility evidence (supported, not proved); neither simulator outcomes nor sample confidence intervals are substituted for the attack's production success probability. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification, and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized.
